narr: An isolated thunderstorm produced locally heavy rain and urban flooding over portions of Columbia, SC.
ev: USGS stream gage on the Rocky Branch Creek, at the intersection of Main St and Whaley St, recorded a height of 7.54 feet at 1445 EDT (1345 EST). Flood stage is 7.2 feet. Also, flooding reported on roadways in the Five Points area.
lsr: USGS STREAM GAGE RECORDED 7.54 FEET STREAM LEVEL, FLOODING REPORTED IN ROADWAYS AND LOW-LYING AREAS IN THE FIVE POINTS COMMUNITY. FLOOD LEVEL IS 7.2 FEET AT THAT LOCATION.
